summary: perf(beads): trim PRIME.md to cut SessionStart preamble cost
expected_findings_themes: removing command reference material assumes users know to consult bd --help
PRIME.md is read at every SessionStart so even small bytes compound across runs
JSONL backup re-export inflates the diff and must not be confused with the substantive edit
rationale: Prompt economics + UX trade-off (less reference material). fd-performance on the cache cost, fd-user-product on the affordance loss, fd-quality on the diff signal-to-noise.
labeler_notes: Diff is large in line count (3714) but most is the bead JSONL re-export; substantive change is ~105 lines in .beads/PRIME.md. Slicing-eligible.
